info.title: doubao-seedream-5.5-layerize Interface
info.description: Use the Seedream 5.5 layer decomposition model to split one image into a base image and multiple editable layers

post.description:
- Seedream 5.5 Layer Decomposition (doubao-seedream-5.5-layerize) separates an image into a base image and independent layers
- Provide `1` input image. `prompt` is optional; when omitted, the model automatically identifies and separates the main elements
- Use `n` to set the maximum output count and `model_params.text_recognition` to enable text recognition
- Processing is asynchronous. Use the returned task ID to [query task status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated image links are valid for 24 hours, please save them promptly

### Output details

- `output_format` sets the base image format. Independent layers are always PNG images with an alpha channel
- Each image in `result_data` includes `z_index` (stacking order: `0` for the base image, increasing from `1` for layers) and `background` (`opaque` for the base image, `transparent` for layers). Layers also include `bounding_box` (`absolute` uses pixel coordinates in the base-image coordinate system; `normalized` ranges from `0` to `1000`), `name` and `description`
- If any layer fails, the entire task fails with a full refund. Partial results are not returned

### Billing

- The base image and each layer are billed individually. The input image is charged separately
- Task creation reserves credits for `1` input image and up to `n` output images. On completion, billing is settled against the actual output count and unused credits are returned automatically

image_urls.description:
URL of the image to decompose (required)

**Note:**
- **Exactly `1` image is required**; omitting it or passing `2` or more returns an error
- Supported formats: `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.jpg` (stricter than plain generation — webp and others are rejected)
- Image size: no more than `30MB`
- Total pixels: `[262144, 6000×6000]`, i.e. at least `512×512` (a higher lower bound than plain generation)
- Aspect ratio (width/height) range: `[1/16, 16]`
- The image URL must be directly viewable by the server, or the URL must trigger a direct download when accessed (usually such URLs end with an image file extension, such as `.png`, `.jpg`)
- The input image is charged separately

prompt.description:
Which elements to split out (optional)

**Three ways to use it:**
- **Omit it**: the model detects every major element in the image and splits them one by one
- **Natural language**: e.g. `Split out the parrot and the title text` — elements are identified semantically and turned into layers
- **Exact coordinates**: use `<bbox>` tags to pin down a position, e.g. `title text<bbox>179 58 809 197</bbox>`; normalized coordinates (`0`~`1000`) are recommended
prompt.example: Split out the parrot and the title text

n.description:
Maximum number of output images, including the base image. Defaults to `30`.

**Details:**
- Allowed range: `2` to `100`. Values outside this range return `400` with no charge
- Decomposition stops at this limit; remaining elements may be merged or omitted. A larger value allows finer separation
- A larger `n` reserves more credits. On completion, billing is settled against the actual output count and unused credits are returned automatically

quality.description:
Output resolution. Defaults to `auto`.

**Options:** `auto`, `1K`, `1.5K`, `2K`

**Notes:**
- Only the resolution options above are supported. Passing an aspect ratio (such as `16:9`) or pixel dimensions (such as `2048x2048`) returns an error
- `auto` makes the output follow the input image: if the original size falls within `[921600, 4624220]` pixels it is kept as is, below 1K it is output at 1K, above 2K it is output at 2K
- Each layer keeps its own aspect ratio from the original image, and the base image keeps the aspect ratio of the input

prompt_priority.description:
Prompt optimization mode. Only `standard` is supported and is the default.

Passing `fast` returns `400` with no charge.

output_format.description:
Output image format

**Options:**
- `png`: PNG format (default)
- `jpeg`: JPEG format

**Note:** This parameter **only controls the base image**. The layers are always PNG with an alpha channel and are not affected by it.

model_params.description: Additional options for layer decomposition. Only `text_recognition` is accepted; other keys return `400`.

text_recognition.description:
Whether to recognize text in text layers

- `false`: Layers only include `name`, `description` and `bounding_box` (default)
- `true`: Layers containing regular text additionally return `text_recognition`: the full `text` (multiple lines joined by `\n`, ordered top to bottom, then left to right), each line’s `bounding_box`, and each text segment’s `text` and `style` (`similar_font_family` for a similar font, `foreground_color` for text color, and the `bold` / `italic` / `underline` / `strikethrough` / `shadow` / `translucent` style flags)

Artistic, handwritten and decorative text layers do not return `text_recognition`.

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback address after task completion

**Callback Timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation is completed

**Security Restrictions:**
- Only HTTPS protocol is supported
- Callback to internal IP addresses is prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback Mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Maximum `3` retries on failure (retries after `1` second/`2` seconds/`4` seconds)
- Callback response body format is consistent with the task query API response format
- Callback address returning 2xx status code is considered successful, other status codes will trigger retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled
